attachments.text:
`arch` command is not installed at default.  
see coreutils document:

> arch is not installed by default, so portable scripts should  
> not rely on its existence.

<https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/html_node/arch-invocation.html|https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/html_node/arch-invocation.html>
